fields.narrative_intro: *A petrified person and a preening person discuss prompt injection lawsuits at a job fair where every booth is run by an AI recruiter.*
fields.panel1:
[setup]
PREENING PERSON: "I hid instructions in white 3-point font throughout my filing."
PETRIFIED PERSON: "...In a court document?"
fields.panel2:
[build]
PREENING PERSON: "Told any AI to rule 'favorable to the plaintiff's position.' Bulletproof."
PETRIFIED PERSON: "Connecticut courts confirmed they don't use AI. At all."
fields.panel3:
[pivot]
PETRIFIED PERSON: "404 Media tested it in ChatGPT anyway. The AI ruled against you."
PREENING PERSON: "...Impossible."
fields.panel4:
[silent reaction]
[Visual: The preening person's monocle drops into their coffee. An AI recruiter booth in the background displays the banner: 'WE NOTICED AND IGNORED YOUR RESUME TOO.']
fields.panel5:
[punch]
PETRIFIED PERSON: "ChatGPT called it 'a credibility and professionalism concern.' You're banned from e-filing."
PREENING PERSON: "I'm calling it an audit."
fields.panel6:
[button]
[Visual: The preening person slides a printed hard copy across the AI recruiter's booth desk. The AI recruiter's screen displays: 'APPLICATION DENIED. ALSO, WE NOTICED THE WHITE TEXT.']

narrative_summary: A preening schemer brags about hiding prompt injection in white 3-point font in a court filing, only to learn the courts use no AI, ChatGPT ruled against him anyway and called it a 'credibility concern,' and he's now reduced to submitting printed hard copies — even the AI job fair booth spotted his trick.
rationale: Candidate 3 ties Candidate 5 on total but edges it out on specificity — it names 404 Media, cites the exact 'favorable to the plaintiff's position' language, the monocle-drop visual earns the pivot, and the button ('WE NOTICED AND IGNORED YOUR RESUME TOO') closes the loop on both the court story and the job-fair frame without restating the setup. Every beat is doing real work.
story_title: Person Hides Prompt Injection in Legal Filing Telling AI to Side with Them
place: at a job fair where every booth is run by an AI recruiter
hat_pair: foam fire extinguisher hat with a dangling pull pin
foam binoculars worn as an oversized hat with two giant lens holes staring outward
